thread:
sarah_sales: Quick heads-up — ZenithHealth LOI landed. Need final throughput map, reserved GPU sizing, and autoscale handoff for the POC -> commit. Main asks: p95 latency target 200ms, expected peak 600 rps, avg tokens ~120. Any immediate blockers?
liam_soleng: Nice! Quick q: is 600 rps steady or short spikes? Also what model family are they planning to use (2x Llama-variant / 8k context)?
ravi_sre: From infra side: we can do reserved pool + burst credits. Recommend sizing for steady-state ~70% of reserved capacity and allow bursts up to 2.5x with credit throttle. Preheat window should be 20–30m to populate KV cache if we expect prefix reuse.
maria_sales: Pricing note for finance — customer expects committed discount band based on reserved GPU tier. If we recommend extra prewarm capacity for launch week, how do we quote that?
liam_soleng: For 600 rps and ~120 tokens/request, rough token/s = 600*120 = 72k tokens/s. With our tuned fp16 model on A100-80 (~est 150k toks/s per GPU in our profile for short sequences) I'd propose starting with 1 reserved A100-80 + 1 burst A100 reserved (or spot) for headroom. If they want lower cost, use quantized variant on V100-class for less throughput but cheaper.
sarah_sales: Can we make that recommendation in writing for the customer? They asked for concrete autoscale thresholds and fallback tiers.
liam_soleng: Yes. Sample policy to hand off to ops: 
```
reserved_pool: 2 x A100-80
autoscale:
  - metric: queue_depth
    scale_up: > 50 requests for 30s
    scale_down: < 10 requests for 120s
  - metric: token_throughput
    scale_up: > 80k toks/s sustained 60s
fallback:
  - primary: fp16-A100
  - fallback1: q4_quant-A100 (lower cost, slightly higher latency)
  - fallback2: q4_cpu (for extreme failover)
preheat_window_minutes: 30
kv_warmup_strategy: replay_top_n_requests: 200
```
ravi_sre: +1. Also add circuit-breaker: if avg p99 latency > 1.2s for 2 minutes, route new sessions to fallback variant and page oncall. That keeps SLA intact.
maria_sales: For the pricing ask: reserved capacity + 1-week prewarm add-on as a one-time charge, or roll into commit as ramped usage credit. Finance prefers commit credit model — I'll draft numbers once liam confirms GPU choices.
jon_eng: Security heads-up: for enterprise commit we need to confirm KMS integration and allowed logging retention on their contract. If Zenith requires VPC private deployment, throughput mapping may change because network egress and within-VPC GPU placement vary.
liam_soleng: Good call. If they choose Private (VPC), we should assume slightly higher cold-starts; increase preheat to 45m and add a KV warmup job replaying historical traffic to reach ~90% hot-key coverage before go-live.
sarah_sales: Can someone create a short runbook for the POC handoff (autoscale knobs, pricing delta, security checklist)? Need to share with customer tomorrow.
liam_soleng: I'll draft the runbook and attach capacity calc + fallback examples. Will link here when done.
deploy-bot: deployment: reserved-pool/provision-request queued — id: rp-410111; ETA 45m.
sarah_sales: Awesome — thanks team. cc @maria_sales for pricing, @ravi_sre for oncall runbook, @jon_eng for security closure. :thumbsup:
